{{Quote|I didn't leave one empire to be trampled by another. Let's finish this war.|Veeroa Denz, on the Sith and Eternal Empires|<ref name="Recruitment" />}}
'''Veeroa Denz''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolyte]] at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the [[Galactic War]] who escaped the world to the moon [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] after a [[Attack on Korriban|Zakuulian attack]]. Zakuul's arrival to her new home led her to work for the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against the [[Eternal Empire]].

==Biography==
A Nautolan [[Slavery/Legends|slave]], Denz's [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force sensitivity]] led her to the Sith Academy on Korriban where she faced a [[Veeroa Denz's overseer|cruel Overseer]]. She escaped her training when a Zakuulan attack struck the Academy, [[Death/Legends|killed]] her [[Overseer (Sith)|overseer]] and fled to Nar Shaddaa in order to start a new life while helping fugitives from the [[Eternal Empire]].<ref name="Resistance" />

She allied herself with [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]] in the fight against the Eternal Empire after the two destroyed the [[Star Fortress]] [[Nar Shaddaa Star Fortress|orbiting Nar Shadaa]], lending her help until the destruction of [[Zakuul]].<ref name="Recruitment" />

==Behind the scenes==
Veeroa Denz was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the digital expension [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], as the local contact for Nar Shaddaa in the Star Fortress series mission.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' {{1st}}
